rationale: Y has a richer hero (radar cell map, hourly bars, curl request), a warm orange accent against deep navy, light/dark section rhythm, and a distinct illustration on each of six feature cards. X is a competent all-dark monospace developer page with a good forecast panel, but it is uniform and low-contrast in places, and its feature section is sparser, so it reads as the more template-like dark dev-tool page. Y's hero headline has very tight tracking, but overall it is the one a design director would ship.
